prompt: Stage 3-2 silver augment, level 6, 44 gold, 76 HP. Your frontline is Leona, Shen and Ornn, all 2-star: three Defenders, and Defender activates at 2, 4 and 6. Your items are already slammed and no component is loose. Options: Trait Heart for Defender (+1 Defender), Component Anvil (one component of your choice now) and Second Wind (heal 20 HP over four rounds). Which do you take?
explanation:
A +1 trait augment is worth exactly one thing: a breakpoint you cross the moment you take it and hold for the rest of the game. Here it does both. Three Defenders plus the Heart is Defender 4 this round, with no unit to find, and it stays 4 when Leona or Shen are replaced later by Rammus or Lillia, both Defenders. It also frees a slot: Defender 4 with three bodies leaves a unit slot for a carry at level 6 and 7, and in stage 3 a slot is worth a breakpoint on its own.

Component Anvil is the tempting one, but with nothing loose the component sits on the bench until the 3-7 drop gives it a partner, five rounds away, and a completed item then is what the Heart's free slot buys you now. Second Wind at 76 HP heals damage you have not taken; it is the pick at 40 HP, not here.

Silver augments are small, so the tie-break is the one you use this round.
principle: A trait +1 is only an augment when it crosses a breakpoint today and stays crossed.
commonMistake: Rating the Heart as 'just +1' and taking a component that sits on the bench for five rounds.
hint: Count your Defenders, look at the next breakpoint, then ask which Defenders will still be on the board at 4-5.
